name: Zake: Website Blocker, Stay Focused, Productive Habits & Wellness Tools
description: Website blocker to stay focused and productive. Calm pause screen, focus score, wellness reminders, and break timer. ADHD friendly.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; connect-src 'self' https://*.googleapis.com https://*.firebaseapp.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com https://zake.app https://getyourlifeback.app https://*.supabase.co
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https://www.google.com/recaptcha/ https://www.gstatic.com/; object-src 'self'
